module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Top-level synthesizable integration wrapper that instantiates the parser, safety controller, CSR/MMIO block, and status packetizer, and wires their real RTL outputs to the declared top-level ports.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Use the parser for packet field extraction, the safety controller for acceptance/rejection and actuator gating, the CSR/MMIO block for firmware-visible configuration and fault clear, and the packetizer for status telemetry. Top-level combinational/registered wiring only; no surrogate computation and no substitute command generation.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Keep only bounded control state in submodules: accepted sequence tracking, fault latches, watchdog counter, clamp registers, configuration registers, and status formatting state. Do not infer large memories or payload storage beyond any optional small FIFO wrapper connection already described in the spec.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive cmd_ready_out from the parser, status_valid_out/status_data_out from the packetizer, csr_rdata_out/csr_ready_out from the CSR block, and actuator_cmd_out/actuator_enable_out from the safety controller. On invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions, deassert actuator_enable_out and do not substitute a fallback command.
ownership_notes: Top-level remains the real design top and is not replaced by a leaf or register-bank module.
All top-level outputs must have real RTL drivers; no output is left tied only to a child input.
The firmware-visible CSR/MMIO interface is reachable by decode and coexists with the streaming interfaces.
Fault visibility is composed from the safety controller outputs and exposed to the CSR block and status packetizer.
The design remains descriptive only and does not redefine ports, filenames, or hierarchy.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_command_parser
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Mostly combinational packet decoder with minimal registered control as needed to honor ready/valid backpressure and reset behavior.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Inspect cmd_valid_in and decode cmd_data_in into packet type, sequence, freshness, velocity, geometry handle, actuator request, and integrity/format indicators. Assert cmd_ready_out when the parser can accept a packet according to the top-level transport policy.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: No large state; only optional small registered staging if required for deterministic handshaking. Decoded fields are treated as packet-local outputs, not retained history.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Produce explicit semantic fields and packet_valid_out only when structural parsing succeeds. Do not invent substitute values or hidden protocol interpretations.
ownership_notes: Consumes packet_fifo_dout only as described by the spec for optional bounded buffering support.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_safety_controller
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Deterministic safety and control block built from flops, comparators, counters, and clamp logic.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Accept a command only when packet type/version match, integrity passes, velocity is within 20-55 m/s inclusive, sequence is newer than the last accepted sequence under the chosen wrap policy, and freshness is within the programmed timeout threshold. Reload watchdog only on accepted commands; otherwise continue counting and inhibit actuation when expired.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Maintain bounded state for last accepted sequence, watchdog countdown, and latched fault bits. Fault clear is a controlled pulse input. No fallback command state is created.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive actuator_cmd_drive_out only for accepted, non-inhibited commands and clamp it between clamp_min_cfg_in and clamp_max_cfg_in. Drive actuator_enable_drive_out low on any rejected, stale, timeout, reset, or faulted condition. Report clamped-output indication, inhibit state, acceptance/rejection pulses, and status summary bits.
ownership_notes: Sole owner of final actuator command/enable behavior.
Implements the required bounded-latency safety enforcement.
Latches stale, timeout, checksum, and range faults for software handling.
Does not silently replace the requested command.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_csr_mmio
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Small reachable CSR/MMIO decode block with 64-bit accesses and response/ready semantics.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Decode writes and reads to the implemented register map for CTRL_MODE, CTRL_FORMAT, WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT, CLAMP_MIN, CLAMP_MAX, FAULT_STATUS, SEQ_LAST_ACCEPTED, FAULT_CLEAR, and STATUS_SUMMARY. Generate a legal fault-clear pulse from the dedicated write register.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Hold firmware-visible configuration registers and readable status mirrors in small control registers only. Reset returns safe default configuration and idle response state.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive csr_rdata_out and csr_ready_out for transaction completion, and export configuration outputs to the safety controller. Reflect real controller state in readable status registers only.
ownership_notes: Firmware-visible state must be reachable through decode.
CSR/MMIO complements the streaming transport and does not replace it.
No inaccessible internal state is exposed as software-visible.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_status_packetizer
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Compact telemetry formatter for the 64-bit outbound status stream.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Assemble status packets from acceptance/rejection pulses, fault summary inputs, sequence tracking, inhibit state, and clamped-output indication while honoring status_ready_in backpressure.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Use only minimal state necessary for valid/ready packet emission and bounded-latency behavior; no payload memory or model data storage.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive status_valid_out and status_data_out with a deterministic status report derived from actual controller state. Report acceptance/rejection, fault summary, current sequence tracking, inhibit state, and clamped-output indication.
ownership_notes: Must not invent missing telemetry or substitute actuation.

sequencing_notes: Command packets are parsed first, then evaluated by the safety controller, then either accepted for actuator drive or rejected with faults latched.
Watchdog reload occurs only on accepted commands.
Status telemetry is derived from controller state and may be emitted independently of command acceptance, subject to ready/valid handshake.
CSR writes update configuration registers through reachable decode and may generate a fault-clear pulse to the safety controller.
On reset, actuator_enable_out is deasserted and no fallback command is substituted.
timing_notes: All logic is intended for a single synchronous clk domain.
Ready/valid and CSR ready/response behavior should remain deterministic and bounded in latency.
Validation, fault latching, clamp application, and actuation inhibition should be achievable with simple registered control paths suitable for FPGA synthesis.
No deep pipelines or large memories are implied.
consistency_notes: No hierarchy, ports, or filenames may differ from digital_spec_json.
